verify.title: Confirm your identity
verify.totpDescription: Enter the six-digit code displayed in your authentication app.
verify.emailDescription: Enter the six-digit code sent to your account's email address. If it expires, request a new code.
verify.bothDescription: Enter the six-digit code displayed in your authentication app.

recovery.title: Enter a recovery code
recovery.description: Use one of the recovery codes saved when activating two-step verification. Each code can only be used once.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot password?
forgotPassword.description: Enter your account's email address. We'll send you a link to reset your password.

checkEmail.title: Check your inbox
checkEmail.description: If an account is associated with this address, you will receive a link to reset your password. Please check your spam folder.

resetPassword.title: Create a new password
resetPassword.description: Choose a new password for your account.

errors.USER_ALREADY_EXISTS_USE_ANOTHER_EMAIL: This email is already in use.
errors.INVALID_TWO_FACTOR_COOKIE: Verification session expired. Please sign in again.
errors.INVALID_TOKEN: This link is invalid, expired, or has already been used.
errors.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
errors.PASSWORD_TOO_SHORT: Password must be at least 8 characters.
